title: Teen Mental Health Research Study Opportunity
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content: Register here

summary: Miami University is conducting a **Teenager Emotion Disclosure Study** for students in grades 9-12. The study examines how teens talk to caregivers about mental health through a **confidential 1-hour online survey**. Participants receive **$15** for their time. Parent/guardian consent is required. To register or ask questions, contact lead researcher Noelle Marousis at **framlab@miamioh.edu**. Study approved by Miami University's IRB (#02456r).

title: Spring EOC Testing Schedule and Winter Results
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
EOC 

TESTING

EOC TESTING

summary:
**Spring EOC Testing Dates:**
- **English Language Arts 2:** 3/24 & 3/25 (one part each day)
- **Algebra & Geometry:** 4/21 & 4/22 (one part each day)
- **Biology:** 4/28 (both parts)
- **American History & Government:** 4/29 (both parts)

Students must arrive by 7:40am to locate testing rooms. Testing sessions run 7:55-9:55am on testing days. Non-testers should arrive at 9:55am or report to the cafeteria if arriving earlier. Adjusted bell schedules apply on testing days.

**Winter EOC Results Available:** Winter EOC state testing results are now accessible in ProgressBook under Assessment Scores > End of Course Assessments. Passing scores: ELA and Algebra 1 require 684+, while Geometry, Biology, American History, and Government require 700+. School counselors will update graduation plans based on scores.

For questions contact Mrs. Hess at HessB@Talawanda.org.

title: Senior Cap and Gown Orders Due
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
SENIORS

SENIORS

CAP AND GOWN
If you haven't done so, please visit Jostens.com to order your cap and gown. Orders need to be placed as soon as possible.Delivery will take place the first week of May during both lunches at THS. Butler Tech students will have their cap and gown delivered to their respective campus.The gowns are rented and Jostens will be here to collect them following the graduation ceremony.

summary:
**Seniors must order cap and gown from Jostens.com as soon as possible.** Delivery will occur during the first week of May at THS lunches (Butler Tech students receive theirs at their campus). Gowns are rentals and must be returned to Jostens after the graduation ceremony.

**Senior yearbook portraits are due March 27th.** Photos must be portrait format, larger than 1MB, and follow student code of conduct. Submit via QR code with access code **talawanda2026** or email to **yearbook@talawanda.org**. School ID photos will be used if no portrait is submitted. Senior ads are also available for $25-$100.
